correctness.rationale: A complete least-unmatched-vertex recursion enumerates 120 one-factors; the complement must be an even two-factor, whose alternating colour assignments exhaust all 504 named proper colourings. All three bichromatic cycle partitions and every legal whole-cycle colour interchange are enumerated. Full all-source BFS gives precisely two components 144/360 and the claimed pair-distance and eccentricity histograms. A second code path searches named three-edge-colourings directly, walks cycles by vertices, and independently regenerates the same graph and metrics. Explicit permutations r, s and a preserve the 36 base edges, generate exactly 144 elements, and act freely and transitively on the 144-state component. The six neighbour elements square to the identity; parity-lift search detects bipartiteness and odd girth five as claimed. The statements are exact finite claims only.

value.rationale: At the natural cubic chromatic-index threshold, Kempe connectivity is the exact reachability problem; a mere class count does not tell how far colourings lie from each other or why classes disconnect. The 144-state sector is an explicit homogeneous Cayley reconfiguration graph with six involutions and diameter four, while the remaining 360 states form an irregular nonbipartite component of diameter six; the ten/fourteen-cycle test recognizes the regular sector directly. Such a sharp, reproducible classification of a canonical 24-vertex symmetric cubic graph is a meaningful finite structural benchmark for edge-colouring dynamics, not an arbitrary slice or a restatement of automorphism order.
